notes: Fixed: pages no longer print as full-black sheets — a page that renders blank (image-decode failure, worker race) is retried once and left white instead of being inverted into an ink bomb, with a warning on the result screen

Fixed: light-blue gel pen no longer disappears or breaks up — blue-family ink (strokes, boxes, violet pens) now survives stain cleanup; cyan pills, paper tints and watercolor washes are still removed exactly as before
New: smart output names — downloads are now named after your document + grid (e.g. "Physical Equilibrium-2x3-printified.pdf") instead of the same notes-printifier.pdf every time
Housekeeping: removed unused UI template files
